# ASP.NET Core + React templates

These templates help plan changes that cross the backend/API and frontend/UI boundary. Copy them into the target project's `docs/` area, remove prompts that do not apply, and verify assumptions against its source, manifests, CI, and deployment setup. Use the common [template catalog](../../../../docs/templates/README.md) when a stack-specific template is unnecessary.

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Full-stack feature specification](spec.md) | Define user behavior, API/UI contracts, slices, and cross-layer acceptance evidence. |
| [Full-stack verification plan](verification-plan.md) | Coordinate server, frontend, contract, and end-to-end checks. |
